_comment: APEX PARAMEDICS · COLOR TOKENS · house type system v1.0. Mirrors snippets/palette.css exactly. Read by generators that cannot parse CSS: python-pptx, python-docx, matplotlib, reportlab, and any script emitting PowerPoint, Word, PDF or chart output. Type values are NOT here; they live in snippets/type-tokens.json. If a value here disagrees with palette.css, palette.css wins and this file is stale.
name: Apex Paramedics
colorNote: Blue is the structure, gold is the spark. Bright gold #FDB61C measures 1.77:1 on #FFFFFF and is never text there. Gold-deep #B77808 measures 3.68:1, which clears the 3:1 large-text threshold only: 18pt print or 24px web and up, never an eyebrow, a caption, a table cell or body copy. Gold is a brand accent, never a status color. Blue light #9699C7 measures 2.74:1 and is never text on white and never a large-area background.

brandPalette._comment: Raw --apex-* palette. Use only where the brand color is the point: a logo band, an accent rule, a chart series.

blue.use: primary brand color, headers, links, buttons, accent bars, chart primary

blueDeep.use: header bands, hero grounds, footers, table header rows

blueLight.use: tertiary accents and hover only, never text on white

gold.use: band rules, accent marks, stat numerals on dark, never text on white

goldDeep.use: gold text on white at 3.68:1. 18pt print or 24px web and up, the .bk-h3 step and above, never smaller

semantic._comment: Identical variable NAMES in every brand kit. type-system.css styles through these. Always generate against this layer, not the raw palette.

border-band-rule.use: 3px accent rule under the header band

status._comment: Identical in every brand so an operational signal never changes meaning between documents. A brand accent is never a status color.

warn.asText: 18pt or 24px and up. Never running copy

diagramRoles._comment: Identical in every brand so a flowchart reads the same in any document. Rectangles at 6px radius. Role is communicated by fill, never by shape. Never invent a hue for a role.
diagramRoles._contrast: Each role names the text color that clears contrast on its own fill; measured, do not substitute. These three fills are house colors, identical in every kit and in brands.json. A brand accent is never a status color.

decision.textRule: large or bold only, which is what a node label is. Never body copy on this fill.

warning.textRule: near-black, not white. White on this amber measures 2.70:1 and fails at every size.

diagramRoles.shape: rectangles, 6px radius. Role is communicated by fill, never by shape.

shadow._comment: The house is flat. Shadow signals elevation, never decoration.

data._comment: HOUSE DATA COLOUR v1.0. Identical in every kit and never forked. Mirrors snippets/data-color.css. A brand accent is never a series colour. Apex maps no slot to its brand accent: Apex blue #2B338D is the brand layer, and series slot 7 blue is the data layer. They are deliberately different jobs. Verify any set with scripts/validate-palette.py. Reasoning and measured numbers in reference/data-color.md.

series._comment: Categorical identity. Assign IN ORDER, never cycle, never generate a ninth. The order is the colour-blindness safety mechanism. Worst neighbouring pair: dE 9.8 simulated red-green and 22.3 normal vision on light, 14.5 and 26.4 on a dark ground. Cap of 3 on scatter, bubble, map and small multiples. Amber and orange sit below 3:1 on white and need a direct label or a table.

sequential._comment: Magnitude. One hue, light to dark, landing on Royal Purple at step 700. Steps 100 and 200 are for continuous scales only. Discrete ordered marks start at step 300. On a dark ground the anchor flips: the lightest step means the largest value.

diverging._comment: Polarity, distance above or below a baseline. Poles are red and teal, NOT red and green: red against green measures dE 5.5 under simulated deuteranopia and collapses into one colour. The midpoint is grey on purpose, because a hue there reads as a value rather than as no difference.

direction._comment: Is this good news. Colour follows favourable against unfavourable. It NEVER follows the arithmetic sign of the delta and never the direction of the arrow: a cost falling and transports rising are both favourable. Every value ships with an arrow or icon AND a word. The ink step is for text on the matching tint fill.

caution.note: Replaces --status-warn #B5821A for anything read as text. #B5821A measures 3.40:1 on white and was never legal at body size.

comparison._comment: The before-and-after chart, which is the most common chart in Royal material. Two tints of the brand hue is the defect this layer exists to fix: they are too close to separate, so the reader has to read the labels. An inert grey baseline against the accent reads instantly.

baseline.use: the prior period. Inert, and nothing to feel about it

comparison.variant: On a single-metric hero slide the result bar may take the direction colour instead. One slide, not a deck: if every bar is green, green stops carrying information.

chrome._comment: Recessive by policy. The grid is a hint, never a feature.

logos._comment: Seven roles. Ask for a role, never a filename. `-on-light` is the file you place ON a light background. The horizontal lockup is the main logo, APEX PARAMEDICS. The compact lockup is APEX alone, for smaller places, decks, or a corner. Apex has no stacked lockup; use horizontal-on-dark.
logos.minWidthNote: The compact minimum is set so the APEX cap is never smaller than the horizontal lockup shows at its own 110px floor. Measured at 1000px wide the cap is 165.50px in the horizontal file and 230.14px in the compact file, so 110px horizontal matches 79.10px compact and the published floor is 80px, or 0.75in in print.
logos.clearSpace: padding on all four sides equal to at least the height of the gold arc
logos.colorNote: The delivered compact files carried #000F9F and #FFB71B. Both fills are normalised to the primary lockup, #2B338D and #FDB61C, so the house ships one blue and one gold. The delivered originals are in the git history, at the commit that adopted the set.

font._comment: Shared across the house. Served from the Collective Edge kit so there is one font file and one place to update it. Point sizes and weights are in snippets/type-tokens.json.
